scientific_integrity: The analytical argument proves infinite-dimensional sharp spectrum, frame versus completeness, and local perturbation law. scientific_limitations: Integer pulse delays, one centered hat spline and fixed redundancy-two rectangular lattice. The odd-delay lower bound is the minimum of a finite explicit trigonometric critical-point set, not generally a radical closed form. Independent publication-priority verification remains outstanding.
title: Parity-controlled Gabor stability for coherent two-pulse hat-spline windows
